    [#D7D7AF]reverse closure, the broadening/escalation rules, and the JSON selection[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]committed manifest from the marker, and add drift and budget guards.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]docs/development.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and the CI guard tests.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]add `just selection-health` to summarize coverage, escalation, and [/#D7D7AF]
